name: session_open
description: Checkout only: open one canonical scene in a persistent offscreen GPUI window and return its session id and semantic generation.

name: session_snapshot
description: Checkout only: return the current redacted semantic tree and generation for a session.

name: session_act
description: Checkout only: click a semantic id, send text or keystrokes, or scroll at a semantic id in a session.

name: session_advance
description: Checkout only: advance simulated time and deliver one animation frame.

name: session_screenshot
description: Checkout only: return a PNG of the current offscreen session frame.

name: session_audit
description: Checkout only: run the semantic accessibility audit against the current session tree.

name: session_close
description: Checkout only: close an offscreen scene session and release its resources.
